description: This circular walk explores Troserch Woods near Llanelli in Carmarthenshire. The walk includes peaceful woodland trails and riverside paths along the Afon Morlais. There's also glimpses of the industrial heritage of the area with old ruined mill buildings. Keep your eyes peeled for a variety of woodland birds too.The woods are also popular with mountain bikers. See the video for more details of the trails.You can continue your walking in the area by exploring theLoughor Estuaryin theMillennium Coastal Park.Pontarddulaisalso lies just to the east of the woods.
